title: private-deployments-weekly-2026-07-13
content:
Private Deployments — Weekly Update (w/c 2026-07-13)
Owner: Avery Chen
Summary:
- Focus this week: unblock three active customer installs, finish the on-prem remote debug tooling, and iterate on the updated VPC peering checklist.
- Overall status: high activity; two installs are green, one remains blocked on customer network changes and one is pacing due to scheduling windows.

Customer highlights / blockers:
1) Acme Health (on-prem, HIPAA) — onboarding
   - Status: BLOCKED
   - Blocker: customer's network team requires BPD/ASN change for BGP peering and won't allow route advertisements until change window (requested for 2026-07-20).
   - Risk: delays SLA start; monitoring stack not yet fully integrated (metrics endpoint still behind internal firewall).
   - Actions: Diego to prepare a fallback plan to use IPSEC tunnel + static routes if BGP change delayed (owner: Diego Morales, due: 2026-07-17). Priya to re-open security questionnaire and flag missing SOC2 attestation items with customer CISO (owner: Priya Kumar, due: 2026-07-15).

2) FinLedger (VPC peering, Dedicated appliance) — in-progress
   - Status: AT RISK -> making progress
   - Blocker: TLS cert rotation script failed during last step in air-gapped mode due to missing intermediate CA on the appliance filesystem.
   - Fix: patched install script to bundle CA chain; ran validation in staging. Samir completed manual rotation for pilot cluster; customer validated on 2026-07-12.
   - Actions: Samir to merge hotfix into deploy-scripts and add unit test for CA chain detection (owner: Samir Patel, PR#234, due: 2026-07-14).

3) EdgeRetail (VPC + S3 proxy for object storage) — mostly green
   - Status: GREEN
   - Notes: Completed S3 proxy configuration and policy scoping. Observability enabled; cost dashboard shows expected delta.
   - Actions: Jenna to finalize doc for S3 proxy permissions and upload to Confluence (owner: Jenna Park, done).

4) DataScale (on-prem, KMS/HSM integration) — onboarding
   - Status: PENDING
   - Blocker: customer requests HSM provider integration that is not in our current supported list; security team needs more info on signing algorithms and attestation.
   - Actions: Engage Security for threat model session (owner: Avery Chen, meeting 2026-07-16). Reach out to partner engineering to evaluate feasibility (owner: Diego, due: 2026-07-20).

Engineering workstream updates:
- VPC Peering checklist revamp\  - Completed draft of expanded checklist covering BGP, route filters, MTU, and NACLs. Found a common misconfiguration: MTU mismatch with site VPN endpoints causes occasional packet fragmentation for KV cache sync.\  - Action: Add MTU validation step to pre-install checklist (owner: Avery, done).
- Remote debug tooling (on-prem agent)\  - Implemented improved diagnostic bundle (collect logs, netstat, iptables, disk layout) that uploads via secure channel when allowed.\  - Progress: agent 0.9.1 released to staging; remote bundle collection validated on FinLedger pilot.\  - Next: add scrubber for sensitive fields before upload (owner: Priya, due: 2026-07-20).
- Installer & scripts\  - Hotfixes for cert chain and CA detection in air-gapped installs merged to staging.\  - TODO: add better retry/backoff for mount points (NFS/CIFS) — observed intermittent mount failures in two customer installs.
- Observability & runbooks\  - Updated private-deploy runbook with clearer escalation path and required customer contact info template.\  - Added guide for how to toggle verbose kernel logs safely on on-prem machines.

Standup highlights (this week's daily blurbs):
- Mon: Diego — triaged Acme Health BGP issue; scheduled customer call. Samir — reproduced cert rotation failure and started patch. Priya — security questionnaire follow-up. Jenna — S3 proxy testing.
- Tue: Diego — outlined IPSEC fallback plan. Samir — patch ready for staging. Priya — started scrubber implementation. Jenna — documentation draft.
- Wed: All-hands with CS — aligned on support hours for installs and escalations; confirmed limited weekend windows for Acme Health.
- Thu: Samir — manual rotation completed for FinLedger pilot. Diego — BGP change request waiting for customer CAB. Avery — coordinated security session for DataScale.
- Fri: Wrap-up — verified staging installs; published updated runbook; queued remaining action items.

Risks & mitigation:
- Network windows cause schedule slip: mitigation is to prepare fallback IPSEC/static route plan to limit single-point dependencies on customer CAB schedules.
- Air-gapped cert handling edge-cases: mitigation is to add CA bundle checks, unit tests, and a one-click manual rotation playbook.
- On-prem observability gaps (metrics behind firewall): mitigation is to provide secure relay pattern and minimal agent metrics that can be exported via customer-managed gateway.

Action items (owner — due)
- Diego Morales — IPSEC fallback plan + playbook for Acme Health — 2026-07-17
- Priya Kumar — implement scrubber for diagnostic bundle uploads — 2026-07-20
- Samir Patel — merge cert hotfix + add CA detection unit test (PR#234) — 2026-07-14
- Avery Chen — schedule threat-model session with Security for DataScale HSM request — 2026-07-16
- Jenna Park — finalize and publish S3 proxy permissions doc — 2026-07-13 (done)

Notes / loose threads:
- Need a decision: support for additional HSM vendors vs. recommended partner list. Capture trade-offs and SLA impacts for leadership review.
- Consider a short-run customer-facing checklist pdf we can email before install kickoff (reduce pre-install back-and-forth).

Next week priorities:
- Unblock Acme Health or execute fallback plan.
- Finish scrubber and harden remote debug agent.
- Merge and promote installer hotfixes to prod after one more pilot test.
- Prepare one-page pre-install checklist for CS/solutions engineering.

Meeting notes:
- 2026-07-12: Weekly install sync (attendees: Diego, Samir, Priya, Jenna, Avery, CS reps)\  - Agreed to accelerate FinLedger rollout pending certification fix.\  - Agreed Diego will lead Acme Health escalation.

Attachments / references:
- Confluence runbook (linked), JIRA tickets PD-4123 (Acme Health), PD-4178 (DataScale HSM), PR#234 (cert hotfix).

End of report.
